label: Bible Study
prompt: And they _____ him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
verse: And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy:
note: After the ascension, the disciples headed back to Jerusalem — not sad, but full of joy.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples _____, when they saw the Lord.
verse: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the Lord.
note: Behind locked doors, Jesus showed them His hands and side, and fear turned to gladness.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And there shall come forth a _____ out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
verse: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
note: A rod from the stem of Jesse — a new shoot from David's family stump, long after the tree looked dead.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath _____ death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
verse: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
note: Paul, writing from prison: Christ hasn't merely delayed death — he's abolished it and brought life to light.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: A _____ woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
verse: A virtuous woman is a crown to her husband: but she that maketh ashamed is as rottenness in his bones.
note: Long before the famous chapter 31, Proverbs already calls 'a virtuous woman' a crown to her husband.
